activities.activity_description: Implement a complete Kafka data pipeline example in Spring XD demonstrating log aggregation and lambda architecture. Includes creating producer/consumer configurations, multiple streams for different use cases, and comprehensive documentation.
Implement Sqoop batch samples for both JDBC to HDFS and HDFS to JDBC data movements. Includes configuring Sqoop jobs, creating batch definitions, and writing documentation.
Modify the Gradle build scripts to remove the pushGeneratedDocs task and related documentation generation tasks, and remove obsolete link rewriting configuration.
Create a comparison document analyzing Spring XD's Storm implementation examples against raw Storm implementations, highlighting differences in approach and implementation.
Create a comparison document analyzing Spring XD's Spark Streaming implementation examples against raw Spark implementations, focusing on integration and simplification aspects.
Port the Smart Grid demo from s1-2014 to the current Spring XD samples repository. Includes updating dependencies, refactoring code to use current APIs, and adapting to new project structure.
Create a standalone example demonstrating JDBC to HDFS data movement using Spring XD's stream capabilities. Includes database configuration, HDFS sink setup, and documentation.
Implement the --nameExpression option for file sink streams, allowing complete control over filename generation. Includes modifying parser, options classes, adding tests, and updating documentation.
